name: MedExQA
intro: MedExQA是覆盖五个代表不足医学专业的英文多选问答基准，共965道题，每题配两份写作风格不同且经过人工核验的解释。数据来自可免费访问的在线模拟测试和考试，经过问题与解释去重、BERT余弦相似度近重复筛除、法律法规关键词过滤和选项重排，再划分为25条开发集和940条测试集，用于联合评估答案分类与解释生成。
build_method: 在线考试人工汇集, 精确与语义去重, 法规过滤, 选项重排, 双解释人工核验
eval_feature: 五个低代表专业, 每题双解释, 答案错误时解释得分归零
build_method_en: Manual online-exam collection, exact and semantic deduplication, regulation filtering, option shuffling, dual-explanation human validation
eval_feature_en: Five underrepresented specialties, two explanations per item, zero explanation score for wrong answers
intro_en: MedExQA is an English multiple-choice QA benchmark spanning five underrepresented medical specialties. Its 965 questions each have two human-validated explanations in distinct writing styles. Questions from freely accessible online mock tests and exams undergo question and explanation deduplication, BERT-cosine near-duplicate removal, law or regulation keyword filtering, and option shuffling before a 25-item development and 940-item test split for answer-classification and explanation-generation evaluation.

drawio_review_note: Audited against arXiv:2406.06331v2, official code knowlab/MedExQA@9a5b34af103b0c8ba0c00906e278f6572249fafa, and official dataset bluesky333/MedExQA@3a9f80d6de2c354956d7e86d323214b92d547d6e. The bilingual diagrams preserve the five specialties and exact 148/377/111/194/135 counts; freely accessible mock-test and online-exam collection, with the reported 60% source pass mark explicitly treated as descriptive rather than a selection filter; question and explanation deduplication; BERT-cosine near-duplicate removal; law/regulation keyword filtering; option shuffling; two distinct, human-validated explanations with 78.7% overall pair similarity; the exact 25-development/940-test split; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 noncommercial and nonclinical-use limits; 18 open baselines, MedPhi-2, and three GPT snapshots; zero-shot, batch-one, temperature-zero evaluation; the separate 19-row logits and 22-row chat arms; the released regex/thefuzz parser's no-abstain fallback; wrong-answer explanation-score zeroing; paper-only automatic explanation-metric evaluation; the three-Health-MSc, 25-development-item human rubric (0 for wrong, missing, or irrelevant; 0.5 for a correct answer with a wrong or incomplete rationale; 1 for both correct); and five-specialty aggregation. Explicit boundaries identify undisclosed source URLs/raw counts/upstream item rights, BERT checkpoint/threshold, keyword list, shuffle seed, explanation provenance, construction-review staffing/adjudication/agreement, human-review assignment/raters-per-item/aggregation/adjudication/agreement, multi-reference reduction, metric versions, runner failures, missing-row denominator, and the released repository's lack of explanation-metric, human-evaluation, and macro-aggregation code. The CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 statement applies to the released dataset; the fixed code snapshot has no LICENSE file, and the README Leaderboard is a static result table with no submission mechanism. Formal publication evidence [site-a11t-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1947×1505 (English) and 1891×1505 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1945×1503 and 1889×1503. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
